name: Invictus Strategic Solutions Ltd
tagline: Veteran-owned training in pre-hospital emergency care, first aid, hostile environments and travel risk
offer: 5% off any Invictus course for Hostile Environment Jobs members. Mention us when you book.

about:
Invictus Strategic Solutions is a veteran-owned UK training and consultancy company. Its instructors come from specialist military, law enforcement, security and frontline pre-hospital emergency care backgrounds.

It runs Qualsafe FREC 3 and FREC 3 requalification courses near Bicester, a residential HEAT course at the Fire Service College, and bespoke HEAT for organisations on request. It works with people and teams in the security, humanitarian, international travel and high-risk sectors.
